records.title: Foundational Education: Learning Guide 1
records.content: Foundational education develops literacy, numeracy, communication, critical thinking, and social skills. Primary and secondary schools provide structured learning through classroom instruction, projects, assessments, and extracurricular activities.
learning_objectives: Understand the key concepts and terminology.
Apply the concepts to practical learning situations.
Evaluate information and explain conclusions clearly.
